name: design-to-dev
description: design-to-dev: turn designs or a product idea into a runnable prototype, design tokens and a developer handoff.

plugins.name: design-to-dev
plugins.description: For designers: screenshots, Figma links, brand guides or a text idea become a clickable prototype (plain HTML/CSS/JS, fake data, key states), design tokens (CSS + W3C JSON) and HANDOFF.md, with every item marked Fixed, Indicative or TBD.
